input.summary: Ported fir.cu to fir.sycl.cpp in plain SYCL 2020 with no dpct headers or helpers. The 64 taps are captured by value in the kernel lambda instead of using constant memory. The kernel is a 1-D nd_range that stages the tile through a local_accessor. Compiled with add_dpct_include=false. On a synthetic stereo WAV I made, the max difference from the reference output was 8.9e-8, well within the 1e-5 atol. I did not run the audio dBFS null check itself.
